description: This file defines a single function 'makeOpenAIImageEditsRequest' that performs image editing requests using OpenAI's API. It handles multiple images, manages API credentials and headers, processes responses, updates UI components, and handles errors.

methods.name: makeOpenAIImageEditsRequest
methods.description: Asynchronously sends image editing requests to OpenAI API, handles multiple images, updates UI with results, and manages errors and user notifications.
